scripts.check:assets: rm -rf .assets-check && bun scripts/build-assets.ts --out .assets-check && diff -r .assets-check/build assets/build && diff .assets-check/atlas-manifest.ts src/ui/atlas-manifest.ts && rm -rf .assets-check
scripts.check:daemon: rm -rf .daemon-check && bun build daemon/launch.ts daemon/server.ts --target=node --outdir .daemon-check && diff -r .daemon-check dist && rm -rf .daemon-check
